title: Power work formula
statement: For all natural numbers $\ell$ and $e$, the work assigned to computing a power with exponent $e$ is $\ell+e\bigl(W(\ell)+1\bigr)$, where $W(\ell)$ is the binary modular multiplication work at degree $\ell$.
